The season started on 27 September 2021. The season ended with [[Young Africans S.C.]] clinching their 29th premier league title, losing only two games in the entire season. This was the team's second consecutive championship win.{{cite news |title=Yanga SC beat Dodoma Jiji FC to win 29th Premiership title F.C.|Kinondoni MC]] and [[Mbeya City F.C.|Mbeya City]]) qualified for the Tanzanian Premier League play-off, alongside the 3rd and 4th-placed teams from the 2022–23 Tanzanian Championship League ([[Pamba S.C.|Pamba]] and Mashujaa). The Championship teams faced each other over two legs; the Premier League teams then also faced each other over two legs, with the winners remaining in the Tanzanian Premier League and the losers
